items.title: Show HN: Superbase – a SvelteKit rewrite of Supabase table editor
items.contentSnippet:
I don't think there is a better table editor UX than what Supabase provides, but their pricing is steep and local deployment feels clanky and a hassle.
`bunx @xl0/superbase` - no setup, just paste the Postgres connection string into the browser and you get the same experience.
You can also pin it to a single connection url, useful for running it in docker as part of your infra.
